class.name: NetwServerInfo
class.brief_description: What a server tells a server browser about itself.
class.description:
A server browser can check a server without joining it, and gets one of these back. By default it is [method from_session]. Use [method Netw.configure_server_info] to change it. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_server_info(server_info)
func server_info(info: NetwServerInfo) -> NetwServerInfo: info.motd = "Ranked, no friendly fire" info.game_mode = &"ranked" return info [/codeblock] Returning anything but a [NetwServerInfo] makes the browser show the server as broken. Put any extra values in [member metadata].

method.name: from_payload
method.description: Reads a [NetwServerInfo] from [param bytes], or returns [code]null[/code].

method.name: from_session
method.description: Returns a copy of [member NetwSessionConfig.server_info] with [member players], [member app_id] and [member is_local_listener] filled in from the session.

method.name: to_payload
method.description: Writes [param info] to bytes, or returns an empty array for [code]null[/code].

members.member: The game and build the server runs. A browser can hide servers of another game or build.
The game mode, named by the game.
[code]true[/code] when the server itself answered, not a lobby listing.
The round trip time to the server in milliseconds, or [code]-1[/code] when not measured.
The most players the server says it accepts. For display only.
Any extra values for the browser.
A message shown in the server browser.
Who the server asks to be listed to. Each [LobbyDirectory] decides how to honor it.

constants.constant: Listed only to friends, on services that have friends. Otherwise the same as [constant VISIBILITY_PRIVATE].
Not listed. Anyone with the address can still join.
